conventions.plane: overworld plane; layer 0 surface, negative below, positive above
conventions.local_layout: each member map gets a group-local origin (x, y, layer) by BFS over tile links from layout_root (root origin = filename coordinates*size when present, else 0,0,0); N/S/E/W/diagonals offset by neighbour/own width/height exactly as get_map_from_coord(); up/down = layer +1/-1
conventions.placement: plane tile = local origin + tile + (x_offset, y_offset); plane layer = local layer + layer_offset
conventions.stairs: an exit 'becomes stairs' when after placement source and destination differ by exactly one layer and by <= 1 tile(s) horizontally
